{{Top|leg}}
'''Bravo Eight''' was the callsign given to a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[Dren Melne]] served as Bravo Eight prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. He was killed in the [[Battle at TFP-9|attack]] on [[Station TFP-9]] in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] by his own employers after he failed to deliver [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|fighters]].<ref name="The Starfighter Trap">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref> An [[unidentified N-1 starfighter pilot]] also flew as Bravo Eight during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] [[32 BBY/Legends|one year later]].<ref name="Star Wars: Starfighter">[[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]</ref>
